main_measure.name: mean 5-bar excess return over coin mean on grid bars with forecast >= 2
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and Spearman > 0; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: Spearman(forecast, excess return) on signal bars

decided_by: Mean excess return above 0 with t >= 2 and Spearman correlation above 0 (confirm rule).
reading: A bar is in the situation when the raw component value is above 0 (long side); grid bars are positions 0,5,10,... of each window with close[t+5] inside the window, and the coin's mean 5-bar return is taken over all its windows' grid bars together.
